Subject: Renewal: EU region add + APAC pilot — data partitioning and throughput bump

Hi Emma / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As StellarHealth approaches renewal next quarter, we wanted to put a short note outlining the options we discussed: adding an EU-hosted model instance for EU patient data, and a small APAC pilot for your Singapore edge deployments. High-level asks from your side were:

- Data partitioning so EU traffic & logs stay in the EU tenancy
- A 20% throughput bump during business hours for your reporting window
- Short APAC pilot (3 months) with burst capacity for regional tests

Attached are two docs: a draft SOW that shows scope & timelines, and a term sheet with the proposed dedicated capacity bump. Key questions for us to confirm before we update the renewal:

1) Does procurement require EU-only billing/legal language?
2) Does your security team need SOC-2 artifacts scoped to EU-only deployment?
3) Desired start date for EU cutover and APAC pilot window?

If it helps, I can route the SOW to your procurement contact directly. Can we set a 30-minute slot this week to lock dates so we can firm up pricing?

Best,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Thanks Ben —

Appreciate the summary. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Procurement: please loop procurement@stellarhealth.com on the next draft. They will need EU-specific contract language (data controller/processor clauses).
- Security: we will need SOC 2 Type II report plus proof of EU key-management separation (or HSM attestation).
- Timing: looking to have EU region live by Jul 1st to meet a regulatory pilot. APAC pilot can be Sept—Nov (3 months).

A note on throughput: Rajiv will share typical Q3 reporting traffic so we can size the 20% bump properly.

Can you also include a short runbook for cross-region failover behavior? Our ops team needs to understand RTO and data access paths.

Hi all —

Attached is a concise draft runbook and technical note covering:
- EU tenancy provisioning steps and KMS scope (separate keyrings per customer EU instance)
- Data partitioning: logical separation at routing layer + S3 bucket policies scoped to eu-west-1 account
- Cross-region failover behavior:
  * Active in EU for EU traffic; APAC only for APAC pilot
  * In disaster scenario we will failover to EU-secondary (cold-warm) with RTO target 2 hours for control-plane recovery, 6 hours for full model cache rebuild (KV warming plan included)
- Throughput bump: recommend horizontal shard + dedicated worker pool during 06:00–10:00 UTC to meet reporting peak — estimated cost in attached spreadsheet

Attachments: Throughput_Bump_Costing_StellarHealth.xlsx

I've kept the ops runbook intentionally short for procurement/security review; Rafael will expand into a full runbook if StellarHealth requests more detail.
